items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 10 at 7:20PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
At 720 PM AKDT, Satellite imagery indicated a strong thunderstorm 16
miles east of White Pass, moving southwest at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph.

SOURCE...Satellite indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Skagway Customs, Skagway, Chillkoot Trail Flood Area, White Pass,
and Dyea.
items.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

items.headline: Red Flag Warning issued July 10 at 2:45PM AKDT until July 11 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* Winds...Southeast 15 to 25 mph. Gusts up to 40 mph.

* Timing...Hot, dry, windy conditions expected to begin by noon,
persisting into the evening, as temperatures cool by 7pm.

* Relative Humidity...As low as 20 percent.

* Temperatures...In the lower to mid 70s for lower elevations.

* Location...Areas along the Copper and Chitina Rivers.

* Impacts...Rapid ignition, growth and spread of fires will be
possible.
items.areas: Central Copper Valley; Southern Copper Valley; McCarthy
items.instruction:
A red flag warning means that critical fire weather conditions
are imminent or occurring now, or will shortly. It is directed
toward fire agencies, and through them to the public.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 10 at 12:16PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
South winds will increase from 12PM to 10PM Saturday with gusts
to around 40 mph. The recent heavy rain has loosened soil and root
systems making the trees more susceptible to falling. Wind gusts
up to 40 mph can result in downed trees and isolated power
outages during this time.

If you see downed trees or power lines, please notify authorities
and do not approach them as it can be hazardous.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 10 AM to 7 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Recent
rainfall has loosened soil and root systems, which could lead to
downed trees and a few power outages.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued July 10 at 11:33AM AKDT until July 11 at 11:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 85 degrees expected.

* WHERE...Yukon Flats.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The warmest temperatures will be away from
the Yukon River.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.

items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.
